capabilities: Capture web, wikilink, block-ref, PDF++, Canvas and EPUB sources as reading points
Group reading points into .irdeck topics with priority, suspend and archive
Schedule items on a calendar with daily caps, time budget and overdue handling
Jump back to the source location to resume reading
Import Markdown materials and bulk PDF/EPUB chapters
extras: Freemium: calendar, topics, Add link, Markdown import and basic scheduling are free; paragraph workbench, bulk PDF/EPUB chapter import, folder subscription, load deferral, interleaved learning, advanced charts, timer and associated notes need a one-time Weave series license. Detailed tutorials are hosted on the official site; tag groups are described as still evolving.
problem: Bookmarks and read-later folders only store material, so queues grow without a resumable position or a next date to keep daily load in check.

relations.evidence: If Weave Review (main plugin) is installed and activated, authorization can also be inherited.
EPUB chapter location and jump-back: install and enable Weave EPUB Reader
use PDF++ selection / bookmark links with Add link

summary: Incremental reading queue that turns Markdown, PDF, Canvas, web and EPUB sources into scheduled, resumable reading points grouped in topics.
